Name: Kenneth's Meryenda Time
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Meryenda Time[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Gives your farmer meryenda every afternoon, just like at home.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]In the Philippines, meryenda is a small snack between meals, usually in the afternoon around 3pm. It is not lunch and not dinner, just something light to keep you going, like a sweet treat and juice.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]I made this because I like the idea of having a small snack in the afternoon, not too heavy, just enough to keep going.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]It is the same meryenda every day, a blueberry cupcake, chocolate berry pie slice, pink doughnut, and orange juice. Nothing big, just for the afternoon.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Meryenda is available from 3pm to 3:59pm. Go outside during that time and it will be in your bag. If you are busy and miss it, you wait for the next day.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]If your bag is full, check the lost and found at the mayor's house.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works on new or existing saves. Sleep one night after installing and it will start the next day.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]You will need Kenneth's Dessert Shop and Drink Shop, plus SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Safe to add or remove anytime.[/b][/size]
